about_the_game:
This is the official 21-track original soundtrack for Cyan's steampunk puzzle-adventure, Firmament. Featuring a haunting and ambient soundscape, these tracks will evoke glimpses into the unsettling mystery at the heart of Firmament.

The music of Firmament was composed by Maclaine Diemer. He came to this game with more than 14 years of experience, having worked on some of the highest profile titles across multiple game console generations as well as PC.

In addition to his contribution to Firmament, Maclaine’s notable credits include ArenaNet’s Guild Wars 2 and Harmonix’s Rock Band franchises, Riot Games’ League of Legends, Amazon Game Studios’ first major original title Crucible, and most recently Salt and Sacrifice from Devour Studios.
